next.reason: 1985: end-program-header 'must be present if' the program contains or is contained in another program. §2023:10.7.3 SR1: 'An end marker shall be present in every source unit that contains, is contained in, or precedes another source unit.'; §2023:10.7.3 SR3 requires the contained program's END PROGRAM marker before the container's. The 'precedes' case was already a 1985 requirement (§1985:VI.2.3.3 GR2: each program of a sequence but the last terminated by an end program header), so the same programs are refused.
